rows.grounds: indeclinable adverb referring to the previously described procedure
absolutive expressing a prior contemplative act
instrumental plural indicating means of worship performed in the mind
absolutive expressing a prior act of worship
compound naming the ritual act to be performed; śaṅkha+sthāpana
optative prescribing the next ritual action

items.question: What ritual action must be performed after mental meditation and mental worship?
premises: The practitioner has thus completed meditation.
The practitioner has performed worship with mental offerings.
A prescribed ritual action follows these mental acts.
items.inference: After meditating and worshipping with mental offerings, the practitioner should perform the placement of the conch.
uncertainties: The specific ritual details of śaṅkhasthāpana are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having thus meditated and worshipped with mental offerings, one should perform the placement of the conch.
